text.en:
The Secretary of the Interior shall for every period of five consecutive years order an adjustment
made t of the salaries of the provincial officers of the Provinces of Batanes, Camarines Norte, Marinduque,
Masbate, Mindoro, and Palawan, on the basis of the rules established in Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred
and twenty-nine of the Philippine Legislature.
All acts or parts of acts inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 8, 1922.
